summary_md: **jhug ([@JoshHughes___](https://x.com/JoshHughes___/status/2116335245318644016))** introduces **Local Model Access (LMA)**. A phone stores one model file, and sites that support LMA verify it against a Hugging Face SHA-256 and stream it to the GPU, so nothing is uploaded or downloaded twice. Sites embed a chat widget or run headless, the code is Apache-2.0 and the spec CC BY 4.0. It was tested on iPhone with Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B and Gemma 4 E2B ([ArtistJoshHughes/local-model-access](https://github.com/ArtistJoshHughes/local-model-access), [p0pc0rn-kernels](https://github.com/ArtistJoshHughes/p0pc0rn-kernels)).
